entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: The blue-aligned god of Wisdom and the Cosmos from Kaldheim, who sometimes disguises himself as the human Asi.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane Alrund comes from.

entities.name: Hakka
entities.description: Alrund's Cosmic raven, who flies into all realms to collect knowledge.

entities.name: Cosmos monsters
entities.description: Monsters who hold all the secrets of the world, taken by Alrund as they submitted to him.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: Alrund's adopted son, the god of battle.

entities.name: Cosima
entities.description: Partner of Alrund with whom he had three children.

entities.name: Toralf
entities.description: Child of Alrund and Cosima.

entities.name: Birgi
entities.description: Child of Alrund and Cosima.

entities.name: Kolvori
entities.description: Child of Alrund and Cosima.

entities.name: Jorn
entities.description: Alrund's brother.

entities.name: Hurrik
entities.description: Founder of the Beskir clan, who once saved Alrund's life.

entities.name: Beskir
entities.description: A clan founded by Hurrik, given the Feltmark by Alrund.

entities.name: Sigrid
entities.description: A descendant of Hurrik.

entities.name: Feltmark
entities.description: Land gifted by Alrund to Hurrik and his descendants.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: Hunter who joined Alrund (as Asi) and Kaya against a dangerous monster.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who hunted the monster with Asi and Inga.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: One of New Phyrexia's praetors, who invaded Kaldheim.

entities.name: Tyvar
entities.description: Recipient with Kaya of Alrund's instruction about the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: A sword that Alrund said must be given to Halvar to end the Doomskar.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: A calamity provoked by Tibalt.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Provoked the Doomskar.

events.summary: Alrund undertakes a quest to become the wisest being, taking secrets from each Cosmos monster as it submits over centuries.
events.quote: By making every Cosmos monster submit to him one by one over centuries, Alrund was able to take their secrets from them.

events.summary: Alrund finds an orphaned baby in an eagle's nest on Axgard, adopts him as Halvar, and leaves him as ward of the dwarf king for twenty years.
events.quote: Alrund adopted the baby as his son and named him Halvar

events.summary: Hurrik saves Alrund's life and Alrund gifts the Feltmark to Hurrik and his descendants.
events.quote: Alrund gifted the Feltmark to Hurrik and his descendants

events.summary: As Asi, Alrund joins Inga Rune-Eyes and Kaya to hunt a dangerous monster that proves to be Vorinclex.
events.quote: This turned out to be none other than Vorinclex

events.summary: In Aldergard the party fights Vorinclex; Alrund reveals himself and creates a barrier, and the praetor leaves Bretagard.
events.quote: the praetor left Bretagard, with Kaya soon following

events.summary: Alrund instructs Kaya, Tyvar and the clan leaders that the Sword of the Realms must be given to Halvar to end the Doomskar.
events.quote: the Sword of the Realms must be given to Halvar

relations.quote: Alrund adopted the baby as his son and named him Halvar

relations.note: lived together and had three children
relations.quote: Alrund lived with Cosima for many years

relations.note: Hurrik saved Alrund's life and Alrund blessed his descendants
relations.quote: Hurrik, the founder of the Beskir clan, once saved the god's life.

relations.note: Alrund drove Vorinclex away with a barrier
relations.quote: using his magic to create a mystical barrier between Vorinclex and Inga's people
he joined up with Inga Rune-Eyes and the planeswalker Kaya
